entries.land_location_as_stated: on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond
entries.description: A 45-acre lesbian separatist homestead on a former blue stone quarry with a pond in Saugerties, New York, where three lesbians live and work. They produce most of their own food with gardens, a solar greenhouse, goats, poultry, and fruit trees, hold summer intensives on herbal and psychic healing, and are developing wheelchair accessibility. Welcomes lesbian visitors of all ages.
entries.raw_text: ROWDYBUSH FARM (Susun Weed & Clove), 3136 Fishcreek Rd, Saugerties, NY 12477. Our dream is to be part of a network of SAFE SPACES for wimmin. Right now we are a hard working lesbian separatist homestead on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond. We provide almost all our own food with three large gardens, a solar greenhouse, dairy goats, chickens, ducks and fruit trees (to be planted this spring). We support the land partly by working outside jobs and partly by holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer. We are working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites. We welcome lesbians of all ages as visitors for up to five days, $2-5/day donation. We have/are: 3 lesbians, 45 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative based on '3 lesbians... wimmin living and working on the land' and 'lesbian separatist homestead'. Contact street address is a rural road address representing the land. Num residents 3 based on '3 lesbians' and 'wimmin living and working on the land'. Focuses coded: Disabled women ('working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites'), Lesbian separatism ('lesbian separatist homestead'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('provide almost all our own food with three large gardens, a solar greenhouse, dairy goats, chickens, ducks and fruit trees'), Workshops/education and Spirituality/ritual ('holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('welcome lesbians of all ages').

entries.description: A 150-acre women's land community in Alpine, New York, located between Ithaca and Watkins Glen, in its sixth year. Home to 6 to 10 lesbians focusing on farming, self-sufficiency, and healing. Welcomes girl children, visitors cautiously, and potential new members.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805 (607)594-3536. - (Between Ithaca & Watkins Glen, NY.) Northwoods is in its 6th year as womyn's land, now moving this spring to a more focused use of the land than just gardening and living. We're investing in farm equipment and need work energy. Healing is a focus of many of us. We need everyone here to be self sufficient and self motivated. We welcome: visitors (maybe), new members (perhaps, cautiously), girl children. We have/are: 6-10 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 'women living and working on the land' and seeking new members. Rural delivery route RD 1 Box 156 is the land address. Num residents coded as 6 (lower bound of range '6-10 lesbians'). Focus Farming/self-sufficiency coded from 'investing in farm equipment and need work energy' and 'need everyone here to be self sufficient'. 'Healing is a focus' noted. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (from '6-10 lesbians' and directory context) and Girl children ('We welcome: ... girl children').

entries.land_location_as_stated: in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV
entries.description: A 25-acre secluded homestead in the mountains of Jumping Branch, West Virginia, lived on by two lesbians who are farmers, carpenters, and woodworkers/blacksmiths. They teach skills to apprentices and welcome visitors to help, as well as girl children.
entries.raw_text: MISTY BOTTOMS FARM c/o Mimi & Judy, Rt 86 Box 15A, Jumping Branch, WV 25969. We are building a womyn's homestead on 25 acres in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV. Secluded land, access by foot or 4-wheel drive. We are carpenters and woodworker/blacksmith as well as farmers. Will teach skills to serious apprentices. Visitors welcome and expected to help (bring own food). We welcome: girl children and apprentices. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 25 acres, housing/permanent structure, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('c/o Mimi & Judy', '2 lesbians', teaching apprentices and hosting visitors but not recruiting permanent collective members). Land address inferred from rural route address Rt 86 Box 15A. Num residents 2 from '2 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('building a womyn's homestead... farmers') and Workshops/education ('Will teach skills to serious apprentices'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Girl children ('We welcome: girl children and apprentices').

entries.description: A 40-acre collective in Holly Springs, Mississippi, of seven lesbians striving toward self-sufficiency and mutual support. Described as spiritual, artistic, scientific, and political, and non-separatist. Welcomes non-lesbian women, girl children, boy children, and short-term visitors with work exchange or fee.
entries.raw_text: SILVER CIRCLE FARM c/o Gwen O Demeter, Box 100 Rt 5, Holly Springs, MS 38635. We are a collective of seven wimmin dedicated to caring for 40 acres and each other. We strive to tolerate our differences as well as enjoy them. We are striving toward self sufficiency. Visits require work exchange and/or cash for short stays. Longer visits/meals negotiable. Have communal kitchen. We are not separatists. We are spiritual, artistic, scientific, political, but most important we are loving wimmin trying to give each other space to grow! We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs (but only on leash). We have/are: 7 lesbians, 40 acres, permanent structures (in process), outdoor plumbing, electricity (also hook-ups for couple of RV's), camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative from 'collective of seven wimmin' and 'wimmin living and working on the land'. Land address inferred from rural route address Box 100 Rt 5. Num residents 7 from 'seven wimmin' / '7 lesbians'. Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('striving toward self sufficiency') and Spirituality/ritual ('We are spiritual, artistic, scientific, political'). Note that they explicitly state 'We are not separatists'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children ('We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women').

entries.description: An 18-acre intentional community 35 miles southeast of Austin in Red Rock, Texas, developed by a family of six lesbians with four resident on the land. Working toward self-sufficiency with small livestock, gardens, an orchard, and stained glass and spinning workshops. Welcomes girl children and short visits; substance-free.
entries.raw_text: EARTH CURRENT FARM Rt 1 Box 137L, Red Rock, TX 78662 (512)764-2706. We are a family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land. We are developing a self sufficient space 35 miles SE of Austin, that will provide most of our food and bring in at least part of our survival money. Our plans include chickens, goats, sheep, rabbits, a garden, orchard, and a stain-glass and spinning workshop. We welcome: girl children and dogs (maybe leashed). Visits limited to 2-3 days, $2 per person or work exchange, no drugs, alcohol or cigarrettes please. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 18 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, electricity, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 'family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land' and 'women living and working on the land'. Land address inferred from rural route address Rt 1 Box 137L. Num residents coded as 4 based on '4 on the land'. Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('no drugs, alcohol or cigarrettes please'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('developing a self sufficient space... provide most of our food... chickens, goats, sheep, rabbits, a garden, orchard'), Archives/cultural work ('stain-glass and spinning workshop'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Girl children ('We welcome: girl children').

entries.land_location_as_stated: deeply forested, sub-alpine beauty at 3200'; near incredible Yuba River
entries.description: A 13-acre isolated, deeply forested land at 3,200 feet near the Yuba River in California, lived on by a lesbian couple in their 40s. Actively recruiting 1 to 3 semi-collective members and seeking lesbian buyers for nearby parcels. Welcomes new members, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children.
entries.raw_text: CEDAR c/o Linda or Sara, PO Box 274, Camptonville, CA 95922. We are a couple in our 40's, vegies/non-smokers, living on 13 acres, deeply forested, sub-alpine beauty at 3200'. Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members, very hard to make a living locally, rural, quite isolated, wet winters, hot summers, near incredible Yuba River, other parcels for sale nearby and looking for lesbian buyers. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 13 acres, trailer, shed, electricity/well, camping space, woods, organic garden/ orchard, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative under the exception to the two-woman rule, because the two resident women are actively seeking to expand into a collective ('Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members'). Mailing address is PO Box 274 so land street address, city, and zip are left blank; land state is CA from mailing address and Yuba River context. Num residents 2 from 'a couple... living on 13 acres' and '2 lesbians'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children ('We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women'). No focus coded for Recovery/substance-free ('non-smokers' alone is tobacco).
